question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the spelling error in the given sentence.

The movie is just beggining.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"beggining"** is a misspelling and does not have any meaning in English. (गलत वर्तनी)

 
 
• **Example: **The movie is just **beggining**. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **"Beginning"** refers to the start or commencement of something. (शुरुआत)
 
 
• **Example: **The movie is just **beginning.** (Correct spelling)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Biginning** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling.

 
 
• **Example:** The event is biginning soon. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Beginnig** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling.
 
 
• **Example: **The class is beginnig now. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Begining** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling.
 
 
• **Example:** The show is begining. (Incorrect spelling)
